_note: B15 village post office: mail, packages and delivery nouns. Natural scenes with people using the objects; English sound-alike hooks acted on each item.

fr_poste_noun_f.hook: Drop your letter in the bright yellow POST box – it all goes to the POST office (post).
fr_poste_noun_f.why: la poste = post office, the mail

fr_expedition_noun.hook: The explorer packs his crate for an EXPEDITION and sends it off – a dispatch (ehk-spay-dee-SYOHN).
fr_expedition_noun.why: l'expédition = expedition; dispatch Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ex-pay-dee-SYON -> ehk-spay-dee-SYOHN).

fr_choc_noun.hook: A package thumps down beside him and the man leaps back in SHOCK (shok).

fr_telegramme_noun.hook: The old machine clicks and a TELEGRAM tape curls out (tay-lay-GRAHM).
fr_telegramme_noun.why: le télégramme = telegram Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (tay-lay-GRAM -> tay-lay-GRAHM).

fr_guichet_noun.hook: Lean in at the barred window and say 'GEE, SHAY, can I post this?' – the counter window (gee-SHEH).
fr_guichet_noun.why: le guichet = counter window, ticket office Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (gee-SHAY -> gee-SHEH).

fr_postier_noun.hook: The clerk in the POST cap is the POSTIER – the postal worker (pos-TYAY).

fr_poincon_noun.hook: Thump! He PUNCHES ON the letter with his wooden stamp – PUNCH-ON (pwan-SOHN).
fr_poincon_noun.why: le poinçon = stamp, punch Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (pwan-SON -> pwan-SOHN).

fr_change_noun.hook: The little tray of coins is for CHANGE – swapping one money for another (shahnzh).

fr_emballage_noun.hook: The brown paper roll wraps your package like BAGGAGE – EM-BAGGAGE, packaging (ahn-bah-LAHZH).
fr_emballage_noun.why: l'emballage = wrapping, packaging Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ahn-ba-LAZH -> ahn-bah-LAHZH).

fr_demandeur_noun.hook: She waves her form and DEMANDS service – the DEMAND-ER, the applicant (duh-mahn-DUHR).
fr_demandeur_noun.why: le demandeur = applicant Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (duh-mahn-DUR -> duh-mahn-DUHR).

fr_expediteur_noun.hook: He slides his letter across to EXPEDITE it – the EXPEDITE-ER, the sender (ehk-spay-dee-TUHR).
fr_expediteur_noun.why: l'expéditeur = sender Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ex-pay-dee-TUR -> ehk-spay-dee-TUHR).

fr_envoi_noun.hook: The ENVOY in his red sash brings a sealed letter for sending (ahn-VWAH).
fr_envoi_noun.why: l'envoi = sending, dispatch Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ahn-VWA -> ahn-VWAH).

fr_livraison_noun.hook: The boy LEAVES RAISINS on the doorstep – a delivery (lee-vreh-ZOHN).
fr_livraison_noun.why: la livraison = delivery Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (lee-vray-ZON -> lee-vreh-ZOHN).

fr_remise_noun.hook: The two friends RE-MEET and hand over the package – a handover (ruh-MEEZ).

fr_distribution_noun.why: la distribution = distribution, delivery Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (dees-tree-bu-SYON -> dees-tree-bew-SYOHN).
